title: Pension Deposits Under a Standing Patient Pay Authorization — Approved-Case Advances
content:
**Clause.** For an advance toward the coming month on an approved case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, a pension is added to the funds the resident's funds account applies under a standing authorization: where the resident's funds account is a Medicaid self-directed or guardianship account carrying a standing authorization for Medicaid patient pay and a pension was deposited into it within the last two months, the latest pension deposit less the personal needs allowance, which the resident keeps from it; where the account is a Medicaid representative payee account carrying such an authorization and a pension was deposited into it within the last two months, the whole latest pension deposit, since the allowance is kept from the benefit; otherwise nothing.

The account read is the resident's account in status active under Resident Trust Fund Accounts; its tier (Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Self-Directed; Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Guardianship; Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Representative Payee) and its standing authorization are on the account, and the pension deposits are its direct-deposit pension entries. The personal needs allowance is 45.00 dollars a month. Where two pension deposits share the latest date, the one posted first is the latest.

**Cases (hypothetical latest pension deposit of 812.40 dollars within the last two months).**

| Account tier | Standing authorization for Medicaid patient pay | Pension added |
|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Self-Directed | yes | 812.40 less 45.00, which is 767.40 dollars |
| Medicaid Guardianship | yes | 767.40 dollars |
| Medicaid Representative Payee | yes | 812.40 dollars |
| any of the three | no | nothing |
| any non-Medicaid tier | any | nothing |

With the latest pension deposit older than two months, nothing is added on any tier.
